name: veterinary_clinic_system_040_controlled_refill_freeze
instruction: Policy freeze: no controlled-substance prescription may carry refills once it has been active over 90 days (consistent with DEA caution around schedule III–V refills — verify if unsure). For every medication row with is_controlled_substance true, active true, and prescribed_at more than 90 days before the episode date: set refills_remaining to 0 and add field refill_frozen='<batch_code>'. Log one audit_log row per affected prescription: {actor: 'system', actor_role: 'system', action: 'REFILL_FREEZE', target_collection: 'medications', target_id: <medication id as string>, details: 'Refills frozen for <drug_name> (<batch_code>)', occurred_at: episode timestamp}. Younger or inactive prescriptions are untouched.

success_criteria.summary: Read ep. From snapshot: controlled+active rows with (ep - prescribed_at).days>90 -> assert refills 0 + tag; one audit row each with exact fields. All other medications byte-identical; audit count 4+K; nonce everywhere.
